study.title: Effect of empagliflozin monotherapy on postprandial glucose and 24-hour glucose variability in Japanese patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 4-week study

eligibility.raw_source_text: Established diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus
drug-naïve patients were required to have HbA1c ≥7% and ≤10%
patients treated with 1 oral anti-diabetes agent were required to have HbA1c ≥7% and ≤9.5%
HbA1c ≥7% to ≤10% at the start of the placebo run-in
Written informed consent obtained from all patients
Coronary revascularization, acute coronary syndrome, or stroke within 12 weeks
Active malignancy or life expectancy of less than 1 year

eligibility.value: Insulin, GLP-1 analogues, Sulfonylurea (> half max approved daily dose), Thiazolidinedione (within 12 weeks prior to consent)
eligibility.raw_source_text: treatment with insulin, glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogues, sulfonylurea at > half the daily maximum approved dose or thiazolidinedione within 12 weeks prior to consent

eligibility.value: Prohibited within 12 weeks prior to consent
eligibility.raw_source_text: treatment with anti-obesity drugs within 12 weeks prior to consent

eligibility.value: Prohibited (any treatment at screening leading to unstable bodyweight)
eligibility.raw_source_text: use of any treatment at screening leading to unstable bodyweight
treatment with systemic steroids at time of consent

eligibility.value: Prohibited within 6 weeks prior to consent
eligibility.raw_source_text: change in dosage of thyroid hormones within 6 weeks prior to consent
alcohol or drug abuse within 12 weeks of consent
investigational drug intake within 30 days of consent
Participation in another clinical trial within 30 days

Established diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus
drug-naïve patients were required to have HbA1c ≥7% and ≤10%
patients treated with 1 oral anti-diabetes agent were required to have HbA1c ≥7% and ≤9.5%
HbA1c ≥7% to ≤10% at the start of the placebo run-in
Written informed consent obtained from all patients
Coronary revascularization, acute coronary syndrome, or stroke within 12 weeks
Active malignancy or life expectancy of less than 1 year
treatment with insulin, glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogues, sulfonylurea at > half the daily maximum approved dose or thiazolidinedione within 12 weeks prior to consent
treatment with anti-obesity drugs within 12 weeks prior to consent
use of any treatment at screening leading to unstable bodyweight
treatment with systemic steroids at time of consent
change in dosage of thyroid hormones within 6 weeks prior to consent
alcohol or drug abuse within 12 weeks of consent
investigational drug intake within 30 days of consent
Participation in another clinical trial within 30 days
